title: IngestionEvent
description: Audit record emitted by every ingestion or lifecycle operation. Events live in hoard/_ingestion-events.jsonl (one JSON object per line) and are the answer to 'why is this item here?' or 'why did this disappear?' Events are append-only; errata are new events that reference the original by id.

timestamp.description: When the operation completed (or was rejected).

kind.description: Lifecycle operation or ingestion step this event records.

status.description: ok = written; skipped = idempotent no-op; rejected = validation or policy failure; proposed = change requires user approval (Doctrine).

ref.description: Pointer to the source material (file path, URL, session id).

sha256.description: Content hash of the source when applicable (used for dedup).

target.description: Where the event wrote (or would have written) its result.

from.description: Present on lifecycle events (promote, replace, demote). Describes the predecessor.

to.description: Present on lifecycle events. Describes the successor.

reason.description: Human-readable reason. Required for rejected, demote, doctrine-proposed, superseded-by-hand.

diff.description: Unified diff. Required on doctrine-proposed events.

stats.description: Optional counts for bulk operations (migration-summary, vault-version-imported).

event_refs.description: Ids of prior events this one relates to (erratum, retry, resolution).

actor.description: Who or what triggered the event. 'system' for automated ingestion, 'user' for explicit user actions, or an adapter id.
